# openai_project_service_tier_settings (Resource)

Manage service-tier settings on an existing project. Both settings are managed together. Destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state; the project's settings remain unchanged. Import existing settings by project ID.

Authentication: Set the admin_api_key provider attribute or OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable for the admin API audience.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openai_project_service_tier_settings" "example" {
  project_id    = "proj_123"
  default       = "standard"
  enabled_tiers = "all"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default` (String) Default tier for requests that omit service_tier or use auto.
- `enabled_tiers` (Dynamic) Use "all" to enable all optional tiers, including future tiers, or a list of "flex", "fast", and "ultrafast". Use [] to allow only Standard. Standard is always available. Organization policy and eligibility still apply.
- `project_id` (String) project id

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = openai_project_service_tier_settings.example
  id = "proj_123"
}
```
